query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(*) as dias,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(cat1,0)+COALESCE(cat2,0)+COALESCE(cat3,0)+COALESCE(cat4,0)+COALESCE(cat5,0)+COALESCE(cat6,0)+COALESCE(cat7,0)+COALESCE(cat8,0)), 2) as total_operacional,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(cat9,0)), 2) as total_recorrencia,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(cat1,0)+COALESCE(cat2,0)+COALESCE(cat3,0)+COALESCE(cat4,0)+COALESCE(cat5,0)+COALESCE(cat6,0)+COALESCE(cat7,0)+COALESCE(cat8,0)+COALESCE(cat9,0)), 2) as total_geral,
  MAX(updatedAt) as ultima_atualizacao
FROM faturamentos
WHERE data BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-27'
  AND empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE', 'MORUMBI')
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
